target_customer: Web3 and consumer product teams building communities on Discord and social channels (per a Dec 2022 post); YC page describes marketing teams
problem: Teams cannot see who in their community is engaged, so Blaze unifies social, on-chain and product data into member profiles and automations.
product_category: Community growth CRM and marketing automation

founders.name: Lauren Rothwell
education: MBA, Stanford Graduate School of Business
Economics and Statistics degree, Trinity College Dublin

competitors.name: Common Room
competitors.what: Community growth platform unifying community and product signals
competitors.traction_then: Left stealth with funding in 2021; public launch 2022-03-31

technical_complexity.rationale: Identity resolution across social, on-chain and product data with automations.

defensibility.rationale: Data integrations are replicable and a funded competitor was ahead.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Common Room expanded into signal-based sales; no acquisition of Blaze found.

market_need_then: Crypto and web3 communities on Discord were growing in 2021 to 2022 with little tooling for member analytics.

branding.domain_note: withblaze.app, a .app domain, which failed to resolve from the session network.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with many other Blaze companies; no brand coverage found.

pivots.from: Marketing automation scanning online signals for buyers (YC description)
pivots.to: Community growth CRM for web3 (Daily Dropout post)
pivots.why: Not stated; the two descriptions differ, so this may reflect positioning rather than a pivot

outcome_analysis: Blaze has little public record: a Dec 2022 profile, YC and angel backing, and a founder who later moved to another company per an unreliable mirror. The status in YC is active but the site was unreachable from the session, so whether it still operates is unknown. No factors are assigned because the sources do not tell a clear story.
notes: withblaze.app could not be fetched (hostname did not resolve), so the website is unconfirmed. Founder bios come from the YC page. A directory lists a pre-seed led by Faction in 2022-03 and CB Insights lists $500K in 2024-10 for an unconfirmed profile; unverified. Other Blaze companies exist (blaze.ai, blaze.tech) and were excluded. Whether the claim that Lauren Rothwell now works at ElevenLabs is true is from the YC page only.
